propositions: Direct gated-close phase timings must be emitted without I/O, network calls, subprocess creation, Git commands, model calls, locks, or tracing backends, only using monotonic time and integer arithmetic on the existing call path.

Ten direct timing fields for pre_verifier_total_ms, structural_scan_ms, material_policy_ms, descendant_scope_ms, landing_check_ms, verifier_call_ms, git_history_read_ms, alias_index_build_ms, ticket_ref_resolution_ms, and diff_validation_ms must be recorded and merged into the existing COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics payload before sidecar emission.

Instrumentation must thread an optional timing dictionary through the existing close graph from close_ticket entry through _completion_precheck, _check_work_landed, and related functions without altering function signatures or adding required parameters.
The duration probe must consume direct timing fields when present and label records lacking them as legacy_uninstrumented, never assigning a causal label to unexplained legacy residuals.
Complete added bookkeeping overhead must measure below 50 microseconds per close in a standard-library microbenchmark using ABBA CPU-time differential with 2714 synthetic commits.
